registryEntry.label: Read Defender Signature Currency on Windows Devices
registryEntry.get_command: $d = @(@((Invoke-MgGraphRequest -Uri 'https://graph.microsoft.us/v1.0/deviceManagement/managedDevices').value) | Where-Object { $_ -and $_.operatingSystem -eq 'Windows' }); $s = @($d | ForEach-Object { $m = $_; try { $p = Invoke-MgGraphRequest -Uri "https://graph.microsoft.us/beta/deviceManagement/managedDevices/$($m.id)/windowsProtectionState" -ErrorAction Stop; [pscustomobject]@{ deviceName = $m.deviceName; reported = ($null -ne $p); malwareProtectionEnabled = $p.malwareProtectionEnabled; signatureVersion = $p.signatureVersion; signatureUpdateDateTime = $p.signatureUpdateDateTime; signatureUpdateOverdue = $p.signatureUpdateOverdue } } catch { [pscustomobject]@{ deviceName = $m.deviceName; reported = $false } } }); [pscustomobject]@{ windowsDevicesRead = $d.Count; protectionStatesReported = @($s | Where-Object { $_.reported }).Count; signatureUpdateOverdueCount = @($s | Where-Object { $_.signatureUpdateOverdue -eq $true }).Count; devices = $s } | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 5
evidence_commands: $d = @(@((Invoke-MgGraphRequest -Uri 'https://graph.microsoft.us/v1.0/deviceManagement/managedDevices').value) | Where-Object { $_ -and $_.operatingSystem -eq 'Windows' }); $s = @($d | ForEach-Object { $m = $_; try { $p = Invoke-MgGraphRequest -Uri "https://graph.microsoft.us/beta/deviceManagement/managedDevices/$($m.id)/windowsProtectionState" -ErrorAction Stop; [pscustomobject]@{ deviceName = $m.deviceName; reported = ($null -ne $p); malwareProtectionEnabled = $p.malwareProtectionEnabled; signatureVersion = $p.signatureVersion; signatureUpdateDateTime = $p.signatureUpdateDateTime; signatureUpdateOverdue = $p.signatureUpdateOverdue } } catch { [pscustomobject]@{ deviceName = $m.deviceName; reported = $false } } }); [pscustomobject]@{ windowsDevicesRead = $d.Count; protectionStatesReported = @($s | Where-Object { $_.reported }).Count; signatureUpdateOverdueCount = @($s | Where-Object { $_.signatureUpdateOverdue -eq $true }).Count; devices = $s } | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 5
